# keychain_identity (Data Source)

Reads an identity (certificate + private key) item from the macOS Keychain.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Read an existing identity from the macOS Keychain
data "keychain_identity" "example" {
  label = "Code Signing Identity"
}

output "subject" {
  value = data.keychain_identity.example.subject
}

output "issuer" {
  value = data.keychain_identity.example.issuer
}

output "serial_number" {
  value = data.keychain_identity.example.serial_number
}

output "not_before" {
  value = data.keychain_identity.example.not_before
}

output "not_after" {
  value = data.keychain_identity.example.not_after
}

output "key_type" {
  value = data.keychain_identity.example.key_type
}

output "key_size_bits" {
  value = data.keychain_identity.example.key_size_bits
}

output "fingerprint_sha256" {
  value = data.keychain_identity.example.fingerprint_sha256
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `label` (String) The label of the identity to look up.

### Read-Only

- `fingerprint_sha1` (String) The SHA1 fingerprint of the certificate.
- `fingerprint_sha256` (String) The SHA256 fingerprint of the certificate.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier for this data source (the label).
- `issuer` (String) The certificate issuer.
- `key_size_bits` (Number) The size of the private key in bits.
- `key_type` (String) The type of the private key: 'rsa' or 'ec'.
- `not_after` (String) The certificate validity end time (RFC3339 format).
- `not_before` (String) The certificate validity start time (RFC3339 format).
- `serial_number` (String) The certificate serial number.
- `subject` (String) The certificate subject.
